# 1. Open dataset

```{r}
pca_axes <- read.csv(file="5. Models_par_clusters_pedoclimatiques/5.2. Models/Raw/pedoclim_pca_axes.csv") %>% 
  dplyr::select(-X)

dataset_500_ENI_Lea <- read.csv(file="5. Models_par_clusters_pedoclimatiques/5.2. Models/Raw/dataset_500_ENI_Lea.csv") %>%
  mutate(TypeCulture=as_factor(TypeCulture),
         clust=as_factor(clust)) %>% 
  left_join(pca_axes)

summary(dataset_500_ENI_Lea$perennial_100)
```

# 2. Models

## A. Entomogamous species

```{r}
summary(m0)
Anova(m0)
r.squaredGLMM(m0)
```

```{r}
mod_prat <- lmer(weeds_100 ~ annee + JulianDay^2 + RisqueDebordement +   exposition2+ TypeCulture + Dim.1 + Dim.2 + Dim.3 + IFT_Hors_Herbicide2013_2019 +IFT_Herbicide2013_2019+DivRotation+CoefN+SC_Year_Copper.compounds.1+(1| code_parcelle)  , data=dataset_500_ENI_Lea, REML=F, na.action="na.fail")

Anova(mod_prat_best)
summary(mod_prat_best)
r.squaredGLMM(mod_prat_best)
```
